title: Dream map
content: The metropolis: An image of a huge, monumental, majestic city full of life and light. Metropolis usually evokes a sense of calm and peacefulness, its appearance is changeable, but always with motifs of cleanliness, futurism and "correctness". The metropolis itself is very difficult to describe: tong canals with warm water instead of streets, skyscrapers of all shapes and sizes, neon at night and bright sunshine during the day. Shopping malls, water parks, beaches, all these dreams are similar in feeling and are highly vivid and memorable. Unlike the forgotten city, the metropolis doesn't evoke a sense of loneliness and isn't affected by the disaster. According to various sources, the Metropolis consists of different layers: 1: Skyscrapers: The most populated part of the metropolis, giant buildings are often connected by suspended walkways. 2: Ground Level: Shopping centers and parks, often resembling an underground city or greenhouses. If you're lucky, you might stumble upon a hotel with its peculiar fragmented architecture reminiscent of those playgrounds in shopping malls. 3: Underground: Consists of two level. The train station or the subway is often featured in dreams involving travel and a sense of adventure or loneliness. Connects Metropolis to the bunker and the forgotten city. Labyrinth is located under the subway, it appears to sleeping people as a tangled network of long narrow corridors leading deep underground. Often dirty, sometimes partially flooded. Gives the impression of a place once occupied by people. It is unknown how deep the labyrinth goes, but if you descend long enough, you will probably end up on the surface The forgotten city: A shadow or reflection (and possibly future) of the metropolis. Often appears in dreams as an abandoned city struck by some catastrophe. Sometimes it is destroyed, sometimes it is just deserted. The forgotten city is located on islands and has a strong connection with water and flooding. A lot of people describe some sort of para-military organization that runs operation in the forgotten city and in the suburbs. Sometimes the sleeper is part of it, sometimes its victim. Dreams about a forgotten city often have an oppressive atmosphere of loneliness and hidden threat, although they rarely turn into full-blown nightmares. Here you can also find giant water parks with little or no people in them. The Forgotten City is connected to the metropolis by a bridge, though I've only seen it twice. Although I haven't experienced such dreams myself, some people say they have seen a mysterious disaster in person and that the metropolis will one day meet the same fate. The bunker is in the epicenter of a disaster, very often appears in dreams where you need to flee somewhere and where there are many refugees. Because of its militaristic themes, it is probably related to the mysterious organization. The disaster itself is of an uncertain nature: sometimes it's a zombie apocalypse, sometimes it's a war, sometimes it's a pandemic. The lands around it look scorched, though the bunker itself is not far from the suburbs. The bunker has an extensive network of tunnels and is connected to the forgotten city and metropolis. The suburbs: The ultimate nightmare place. Often people dream that they are being chased by some strange creature or evil person, very often the scene takes place in the suburbs. Far Lands: A vast desert with monumental buildings of unknown nature. Huge cranes lifting airplanes, a field of giant faces, strange monoliths. Dreams here are of the most absurd and surreal nature
